o1: Predicted to enable BMP receptor binding activity and cytokine activity. Involved in several processes, including defense response to other organism, specifically defense response to bacterium; nematode male tail tip morphogenesis; and positive regulation of macromolecule metabolic process. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Is expressed in body wall musculature; nervous system; pm2 precursor; and in male. Is part of TGF-beta signaling pathway. Used to study Marfan syndrome; enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli infection. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in CAKUT (multiple); bone disease (multiple); cleft lip; hemochromatosis type 1; and orofacial cleft 11. Orthologous to several human genes including BMP7 (bone morphogenetic protein 7).
